CP-3: record has_schema_privilege(current_user, 'uellix_stella_ops', 'USAGE') as a boolean. This is a pg_catalog access-check function; it returns false rather than raising when the privilege is absent, so it is the one surface that can distinguish 'no access' from 'no function' BEFORE the probe raises.

CP-4: if CP-3 is false, STOP_FOR_READONLY_CAPABILITY_ADJUDICATION immediately and DO NOT issue either probe. The probes would raise, and a raise carries less information than the boolean already in hand.
MANDATORY_CAPABILITY_PREFLIGHT.why_CP_3_is_not_a_widening_of_the_read_s: has_schema_privilege reads no schema contents, no rows and no object definitions. It answers one boolean about the session's own privilege. It is added because without it the lane's only way to learn the answer is to trigger the error it is trying to avoid, and an error path is a worse diagnostic than a designed one.
MANDATORY_CAPABILITY_PREFLIGHT.CP_3_does_not_authorize_the_probe: A true CP-3 permits the probes to be ISSUED. It does not predict their result and is never recorded as evidence about the catalog's contents.

READ_ONLY_TRANSACTION_CONTRACT.rule: Every authorized statement of this observation executes inside ONE explicitly read-only transaction, and the transaction's read-only property is OBSERVED rather than assumed.

required_form.positive_observation: SELECT current_setting('transaction_read_only') must return exactly 'on', asserted as CP-2 before any other statement.
required_form.close: ROLLBACK, executed unconditionally after the observation, including on the success path and including when the transaction performed no write.
required_form.why_rollback_on_success: A COMMIT of a read-only transaction is harmless and is still the wrong habit to encode: it makes the closing act depend on the outcome, so a lane reading the procedure cannot tell at a glance that no path can write. ROLLBACK unconditionally makes the read-only property structural rather than circumstantial.

belt_and_braces_is_deliberate.layer_1: The role's own session default. db/baseline/stella_g2_roles.sql:182 and db/prepared/stella_0001_role_topology_bootstrap.sql:84 both set ALTER ROLE uellix_auditor SET default_transaction_read_only TO 'on'. MEASURED to take effect on connection without any explicit BEGIN READ ONLY — see ENGINE_SEMANTICS_MEASURED.M-4.
belt_and_braces_is_deliberate.layer_2: The explicit BEGIN READ ONLY of this contract.
belt_and_braces_is_deliberate.layer_3: The grant layer. stella_0021 refuses to build on a database where the auditor holds any write privilege, with its own words: 'stella_0001:84 sets default_transaction_read_only on that role, but a session default is not a grant; the auditor is SELECT-only on the grant layer too and this package refuses to build on a database where it is not.'
belt_and_braces_is_deliberate.why_three: A session default can be overridden by a connection option — db/safety/database-target.ts records that '?default_transaction_read_only=off' does it — so the session default alone is a setting, not a control. The explicit BEGIN READ ONLY is asserted rather than trusted, and the grant layer is what holds if both are subverted.

PROHIBITED_IN_THE_SESSION.rule: None of the following may be issued by this observation, in or out of the transaction, at any privilege level.
prohibited: CREATE TEMP TABLE or any other temporary object
any advisory lock, session-scoped or transaction-scoped
any invocation of uellix_stella_ops.complete_operation_ticket at either arity
any invocation of any SECURITY DEFINER helper

PROHIBITED_IN_THE_SESSION.to_regprocedure_resolves_it_never_calls_: pg_catalog.to_regprocedure performs a CATALOG NAME RESOLUTION and returns an OID-typed value. It does not execute the function it names and must never be followed by a call, a CALL, a PERFORM or a cast that would invoke it. The observation asks whether a verb exists; it never utters the verb.

POST_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIRMATION_DISPOSITION.question: Does D1-8 require a SECOND read-only observation taken after the deployment, or does a single pre-deployment observation suffice?
POST_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIRMATION_DISPOSITION.verdict: A SECOND OBSERVATION IS REQUIRED. Exactly one pre-deployment observation and exactly one post-deployment observation are authorized. The POST observation is the only one citable as D1-8.
grounds: D1_PROOF_CONTRACT.same_deployment_rule requires that every criterion cite the SAME deployment id and the SAME Git SHA, and that a measurement taken against the platform's configuration rather than the deployment's own behaviour does not contribute to D-1. A database observation taken before the deployment existed cannot cite a deployment id that did not yet exist.

D-1 is a JOINT assertion about a runtime and a database AT ONE MOMENT — DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.matrix[D-1] pairs 'runtime NEW' with 'database OLD'. A pre-deployment database reading and a post-deployment runtime reading are two facts about two moments, and the conjunction of them is not the joint state unless the window between is proven quiet.
RULE_OBSERVATION_FRESHNESS makes an observation valid only for the window it immediately precedes. The PRE observation immediately precedes the Vercel mutation, not the D-1 measurement.
POST_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIRMATION_DISPOSITION.why_the_no_DB_mutation_argument_does_not: It is TRUE that the deployment cannot mutate the catalog, and that alone would let the PRE reading carry forward. It does not, because the deployment is not the only actor. Nothing observed by this lane excludes a mutation by another operator, another session or a scheduled job in the same window. The second observation is not there to catch the deployment; it is there to catch everyone else.

NO_INTERVENING_MUTATION_EVIDENCE.rule: The absence of an intervening mutation is EVIDENCED, not asserted. Three controls, all conjunctive.
controls: NIM-1: the two observations return the IDENTICAL classification token.

NIM-2: the two observations return the IDENTICAL regprocedure OID for the seven-argument function. An OID that changed means the function was dropped and recreated even if its name and arity did not move — a change that a boolean presence check cannot see.

NIM-3: artifacts/hosted-chain-attempts.jsonl, artifacts/hosted-remediation-attempts.jsonl and artifacts/hosted-chain-posture-attempts.jsonl carry the SAME final entry before and after the window. These ledgers are tracked, append-only and never truncated, per docs/ops/staging/evidence/README.md. A governed hosted write opens an entry in one of them.
NO_INTERVENING_MUTATION_EVIDENCE.honest_limit: NIM-3 covers mutations that went through the governed chain tooling. It does not cover a mutation made outside it — a dashboard SQL editor, a direct operator session. No observation this grant authorizes can exclude that, and the evidence artifact says so in its own words rather than implying a completeness it does not have. NIM-1 and NIM-2 are what bound the unobserved case: a mutation that left both the classification and the OID unchanged did not change the fact D1-8 asserts.

NO_POLLING.rule: EXACTLY TWO observations are authorized for one execution. There is no third, no loop, no interval, no watch and no retry ladder.
NO_POLLING.a_failed_observation_is_not_a_retry_oppo: If either observation STOPS, the lane stops. It does not take a third reading to see whether the answer changes, because a fact that changes between readings is itself the finding.
NO_POLLING.a_second_execution_needs_a_new_confirmat: A later session is a new execution: new freshness gate, new human confirmation, and its own two observations. Confirmation is not transferable.

The parent grants exactly one deployment and DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_BOUNDARY bounds any retry; spending it to discover a sequence violation the observation could have found first is a waste of a scarce, governed act.

PRECHECK_OLD_DB.when: Before the parent's PMV checks and before its human confirmation, so that a STOP costs nothing.
PRECHECK_OLD_DB.meaning_on_OLD_DB_CONFIRMED: The deployment sequence MAY continue, subject to every other authority — the parent's grant, its PMV-1..PMV-3, its SB-1 SHA freeze, its own human confirmation, and the M11 residual below. This token permits continuation; it authorizes nothing on its own.
PRECHECK_OLD_DB.action_on_NEW_DB_OR_STAGE_A_ALREADY_PRES: STOP before any Vercel mutation. No environment variable is bound and no deployment is triggered.
what_it_explicitly_is_not: It is NOT citable as evidence for D-1.
It does NOT satisfy DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.forward_order step 2.
It does NOT advance any Stage-A precondition.
It does NOT satisfy S1, S4, S6, S9, G12 or M11.

D1_OLD_DB_FINAL_WITNESS.requires: OLD_DB_CONFIRMED, plus NIM-1, NIM-2 and NIM-3 all satisfied against the PRECHECK observation.

the_two_must_not_be_conflated.rule: The two observations carry DIFFERENT tokens, DIFFERENT evidence artifacts and DIFFERENT timestamps, and neither is ever relabelled as the other.
the_two_must_not_be_conflated.why: They answer different questions. The PRE asks 'is it worth spending the deployment'. The POST asks 'what was the database state at the moment the authorized deployment was running'. A lane that took only the PRE and renamed it would be asserting a joint state it never observed — the precise shape of overclaim the parent's D1_RUNTIME_COHERENCE_VERIFIED token was invented to avoid.

NAMESPACE_ADJUDICATION.grounds_for_the_namespace: docs/ops/staging/evidence/README.md defines the directory as 'Mediciones consumidas que ya no se pueden volver a tomar. Cada archivo es la salida verbatim de una sonda read-only, ligada al intento que la midió.' That is exactly what this observation is. The directory already holds hosted read-only catalog measurements that probe the SEVEN-ARGUMENT literal itself — the chain posture and pre-write observations. This is not a new evidence class; it is another member of an existing one.
grounds_for_rejecting_the_deterministic_: The README states the directory's founding reason: tools write to default paths under artifacts/, 'Dos intentos seguidos escriben el mismo archivo, y el segundo pisa al primero', and the witness of attempt att_34fd431f was lost exactly that way. 'Por eso todo lo que se conserva aquí lleva el intento en el nombre.'

This node takes TWO observations by design. A single deterministic path would have the FINAL witness overwrite the PRECHECK — reproducing, in a node whose whole subject is freshness, the defect the directory exists to close.
The README states it again as a principle: 'una línea base que un intento posterior pudiera pisar no es una línea base.'

The date-plus-attempt name is therefore NOT a convenience and NOT invented here. It is the measured contract of the namespace, and the versioned deterministic name is the shape the namespace was created to refuse.
NAMESPACE_ADJUDICATION.working_output_is_separate: The README is explicit that the working directory is artifacts/ and that per-attempt working files there are gitignored and overwritten each run. The probe's raw output lands there; PROMOTION to docs/ops/staging/evidence/** is a separate, deliberate, committed act. A working file is not evidence until it is promoted.

COMMIT_TOPOLOGY.question: Does the durable evidence require a repository commit, and may integration advance before the deployment SHA is frozen?
COMMIT_TOPOLOGY.verdict: YES to the commit; YES, integration may advance.
COMMIT_TOPOLOGY.shape: Each promoted evidence artifact is committed on its own branch and merged as an evidence-only PR whose write set is exactly the promoted file or files under docs/ops/staging/evidence/**. No authority is amended by the promotion and no gate is declared by it.
COMMIT_TOPOLOGY.why_integration_may_advance: The parent freezes its deployment SHA in its own future EXECUTION lane, at SB-1, immediately before its human confirmation, and re-derives it at SB-3 immediately before triggering the deployment. It does not freeze integration at authoring time. A preceding evidence-only merge therefore advances the line legitimately; the execution lane simply freezes the newer SHA. What is forbidden is the reverse: integration advancing BETWEEN SB-1 and SB-3, which the parent already handles with STOP_STALE at FR-6.
COMMIT_TOPOLOGY.ordering_note: If the PRECHECK evidence is promoted before the deployment, its merge changes the integration head and therefore the SHA the execution lane will freeze. That is expected and harmless. The evidence records the TOOLING_SHA it was taken at, not the SHA that was later deployed, and the two are not required to be equal for the PRECHECK. For the FINAL witness they are bound through the deployment id instead.
COMMIT_TOPOLOGY.not_an_evidence_rewrite: A promoted evidence artifact is never edited after merge. A later observation is a NEW file with a NEW name. CLAUDE.md section 5 forbids historical evidence rewriting and this topology makes the rewrite unnecessary rather than merely discouraged.

NOT_A_STAGING_OBSERVATION_PACKET.rule: The artifact this grant produces is NOT a STAGING_OBSERVATION_PACKET and must never be cited as one.

ENGINE_SEMANTICS_MEASURED.classification: ENGINE_SEMANTICS_MEASUREMENT. NOT hosted evidence, NOT a package rehearsal, NOT a claim about any hosted target.
ENGINE_SEMANTICS_MEASURED.binds_to: FROZEN_RULES.RULE_OFFLINE_GREEN_IS_NOT_HOSTED_EVIDENCE: 'No test, gate or evaluation that runs without touching a hosted target may be cited as evidence about a hosted target.' Consumed as given. Nothing in this section is, or may be cited as, evidence about project bvyzblhqymxruxdguaee.
ENGINE_SEMANTICS_MEASURED.what_these_measurements_ARE: Properties of the PostgreSQL engine's catalog-resolution and read-only-transaction behaviour, which determine whether the procedure this artifact authorizes can work at all, and which the frozen parents state in a form that is true in their own context and not transferable to this one.
ENGINE_SEMANTICS_MEASURED.substrate: A throwaway PostgreSQL 17.10 container, created for this measurement, loaded with a synthetic OLD_DB substrate (schema uellix_stella_ops, the seven-argument function only, a LOGIN role uellix_auditor carrying ALTER ROLE ... SET default_transaction_read_only TO 'on'), probed with the two canonical literals verbatim, and DESTROYED afterwards with positive absence verification. No hosted target was contacted, no repository SQL package was applied, and no Uellix migration ran.

measurements.measured: pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('uellix_stella_ops.complete_operation_ticket(...)') RAISES SQLSTATE 42501, 'permission denied for schema uellix_stella_ops', when the session role lacks USAGE on that schema. It raises for the ABSENT nine-argument literal and for the PRESENT seven-argument literal alike. It does NOT return NULL.
measurements.consequence: A privilege gap can never be mistaken for a function absence — which is a SAFETY property, because it means the OLD_DB negative half cannot be satisfied by a role that simply cannot see the schema. It is also why STOP_UNOBSERVABLE_DB_STATE is a first-class branch rather than an edge case, and why MANDATORY_CAPABILITY_PREFLIGHT CP-3 exists.

measurements.measured: With USAGE granted on the same substrate, the nine-argument literal resolved to NULL and the seven-argument literal resolved to a non-NULL regprocedure whose text echoed back byte-identical to the canonical literal. After installing the nine-argument function, the nine-argument literal resolved non-NULL and echoed back byte-identical to CANONICAL_SIGNATURE_CONTRACT.NINE_ARGUMENT_CANONICAL_LITERAL.value.
measurements.consequence: The OLD_DB predicate is non-vacuous in BOTH directions on a real engine, with these exact literals. It also independently corroborates amendment A3's grapheme claim: the substrate declared char(64) and varchar(100), and to_regprocedure normalized them to character and character varying before resolving.

measurements.measured: to_regprocedure over an ENTIRELY ABSENT SCHEMA returns NULL without raising.
measurements.consequence: This is the one silent hole in the negative half, and it is closed only by the positive witness: with the schema absent BOTH probes return NULL, which classifies as UNKNOWN_OR_BROKEN_DB_STATE and STOPS. OLD_DB_DEFINITION's insistence on the conjunction is therefore measured, not stylistic.

measurements.measured: A role carrying only ALTER ROLE ... SET default_transaction_read_only TO 'on' connects with current_setting('transaction_read_only') = 'on' with no explicit BEGIN READ ONLY.
measurements.consequence: Layer 1 of READ_ONLY_TRANSACTION_CONTRACT is real. It is still not relied on alone, because a connection option can override it.

measurements.measured: Under that role, CREATE TABLE and CREATE TEMP TABLE both fail with 'cannot execute CREATE TABLE in a read-only transaction'.
measurements.consequence: The CREATE TEMP prohibition is enforced by the substrate, not merely declared here.
CP-2 is a satisfiable positive observation rather than an aspiration.
